134: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
135: {
136: 	while (rx_count)
137: 	{

151: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
152: {
153: 	u32 address;
154: 	u32 source;
155: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;

157: 	if (!msg)

165: 	}
166: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))

170: 	}
171: 
172: 	address = msg->data[0];
173: 	if (address & 0x3u)

175: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
176: 		return;
177: 	}
178: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
179: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
180: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)

183: 		return;
184: 	}

199: 	rx_count++;

291: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
292: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
293: 		return;
294: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
295: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
296: 	{
297: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
298: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
299: 	}
300: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
301: 	{
302: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
303: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
304: 	}
305: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
306: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
307: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
308: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
309: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
310: }

224: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
225: {
226: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
227: 
228: 	while (ack_count)
229: 	{
230: 		mb_ack_entry_t *entry = &ack_queue[ack_read];
231: 		bk_err_t ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry->data, SELF_CPU,

233: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
234: 		{
235: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry->destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
236: 			break;
237: 		}
238: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
239: 		ack_count--;
240: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
241: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry->destination],
242: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry->destination],
243: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
244: 	}

255: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);

260: 	entry->destination = destination;

262: 	ack_count++;
263: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
264: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
265: 	return true;

314: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
315: 	u16 			chnl_type;
316: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
317: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
318: 
319: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
320: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
321: 
322: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
323: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
324: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
325: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
326: #endif

328: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
329: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
330: 
331: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
332: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
333: 
334: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
335: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
336: 
337: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
338: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
339: 
340: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
341: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
342: 
343: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
344: 
345: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
346: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
347: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
348: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
349: 
350: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
351: 
352: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
353: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
354: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
355: 
356: 	__DMB();
357: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
358: 
359: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
360: 
361: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
362: 
363: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
364: 	{
365: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
366: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
367: 
368: 		return ret_code;
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
372: 
373: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
374: 
375: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
376: 	{
377: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	return BK_OK;
381: }

383: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
384: {
385: 	u8		log_chnl;
386: 	u8		ret_code;
387: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
388: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
389: 
390: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
391: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
392: 
393: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
394: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
395: 	{
396: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
397: 
398: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
399: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
400: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
401: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
402: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
403: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
404: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
405: 		{
406: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
407: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
408: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
409: 			return;
410: 		}
411: 
412: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
413: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
414: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
415: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
416: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
417: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
418: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
419: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
420: 		{
421: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
422: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
423: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
424: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
425: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
426: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
427: 			{
428: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
429: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
430: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
431: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
432: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
433: 			}
434: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
435: 		}
436: 		else
437: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
438: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
439: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
440: 		return;
441: 	}
442: 
443: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
444: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
445: 
446: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
447: 
448: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
449: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
450: 		return;
451: 	}
452: 
453: 
454: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
455: 	{
456: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
457: 		return;
458: 	}
459: 
460: 
461: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
462: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
463: 		return;
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
467: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
468: 
469: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
470: 	{
471: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
472: 		return;
473: 	}
474: 
475: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
476: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
477: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
478: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
479: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
480: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
481: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
482: 	{
483: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
484: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
485: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
486: 		return;
487: 	}
488: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
489: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
490: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
491: 
492: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
493: 
494: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
495: 	{
496: 		/* clear following header members. */
497: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
498: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
499: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
500: 
501: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
502: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
503: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
504: 	} else {
505: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
506: 	}
507: 
508: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
509: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
510: 	{
511: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
512: 		return;
513: 	}
514: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
515: 	{
516: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
517: 			break;
518: 	}
519: 
520: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
521: 	{
522: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
523: 		return;
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
527: 
528: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
529: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
530: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
531: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
532: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
533: 
534: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
535: 
536: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
537: 	{
538: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
539: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
540: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
541: 	}
542: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
543: 
544: 	return;
545: 
546: }

548: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
549: {
550: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
551: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
552: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
553: 	u16 		chnl_type;
554: 
555: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
556: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
557: 
558: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
559: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
560: 
561: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
562: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
563: 
564: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
565: 
566: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
567: 		return;
568: 
569: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
570: 		return;
571: 
572: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
573: 		return;
574: 
575: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
576: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
577: 
578: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
579: 
580: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
581: 	{
582: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
583: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
584: 
585: 		return;
586: 	}
587: 
588: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
589: 	{
590: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
591: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
592: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
593: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
594: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
595: 
596: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
597: 
598: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
599: 	}
600: 	else
601: 	{
602: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
603: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
604: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
608: 	{
609: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
610: 		return;
611: 	}
612: 
613: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
614: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
615: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
616: 
617: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
618: 	{
619: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
620: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
621: 		return;
622: 	}
623: 	return;
624: }

626: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
627: {
628: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
629: 
630: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
631: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
632: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
633: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
634: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
635: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
636: 
637: 	/*
638: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
639: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
640: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
641: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
642: 	 */
643: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
644: 	{
645: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
646: 	}
647: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
648: 	{
649: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
650: 	}
651: }

653: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
654: {
655: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
656: 
657: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
658: 
659: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
660: 
661: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
662: 
663: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
664: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
665: 
666: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
667: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
668: 
669: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
670: 
671: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
672: 	{
673: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
674: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
675: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
676: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
677: 
678: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
679: 
680: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
681: 		{
682: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
683: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
684: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
685: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
686: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
687: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
688: 
689: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
690: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
691: 			}
692: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
693: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
694: 			return ret_code;
695: 		}
696: 	}
697: 
698: 	return BK_OK;
699: }

701: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
702: 
703: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
704: {
705: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
706: 	u16 			chnl_type;
707: 
708: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
709: 
710: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
711: 
712: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
713: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
714: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
715: #endif
716: 
717: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
718: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
719: 
720: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
721: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
722: 
723: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
724: 
725: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
726: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
727: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
728: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
729: 
730: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
731: 
732: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
733: 	
734: 	/*
735: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
736: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
737: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
738: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
739: 	 */
740: 	while(1)
741: 	{
742: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
743: 
744: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
745: 		{
746: 			break;
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	return ret_code;
751: }

754: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
755: /*
756:   * init logical chnanel module.
757:   * return:
758:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
759:   *     failed  : fail code.
760:   *
761:   */
762: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
763: {
764: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
765: 	int				i, j;
766: 
767: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
768: 
769: 	/*
770: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
771: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
772: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
773: 	 * can race here:
774: 	 *
775: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
776: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
777: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
778: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
779: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
780: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
781: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
782: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
783: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
784: 	 *
785: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
786: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
787: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
788: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
789: 	 */
790: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
791: 	{
792: 		return BK_OK;
793: 	}
794: 
795: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
796: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
797: 	{
798: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
799: 		return BK_OK;
800: 	}
801: 
802: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
803: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
804: 	ack_read = 0;
805: 	ack_write = 0;
806: 	ack_count = 0;
807: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
808: 	{
809: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
810: 
811: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
812: 
813: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
814: 
815: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
816: 		{
817: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
818: 		}
819: 	}
820: 
821: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
822: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
823: 	{
824: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
825: 		return ret_code;
826: 	}
827: 
828: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
829: 
830: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
831: 	{
832: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
833: 
834: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
835: 	}
836: 
837: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
838: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
839: 
840: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
841: 
842: 	return BK_OK;
843: }

846:   * open logical chnanel.

996: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;

1010: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1011: 	}

1111: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1112: {
1113: 	u8 phy_idx;
1114: 
1115: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1116: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1117: 
1118: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1119: 	{
1120: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1121: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1122: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1123: 		u8 log_idx;
1124: 
1125: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1126: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1127: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1128: 		{
1129: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1130: 			continue;
1131: 		}
1132: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1133: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1134: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1135: 
1136: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1137: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1138: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1139: 			continue;
1140: 
1141: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1142: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1143: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1144: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1145: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1146: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1147: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1148: 		else
1149: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1150: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1151: 
1152: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1153: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1154: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1155: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1156: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1157: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1158: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1159: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1160: 	}
1161: }

244: 	}
245: 
246: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
247: 	{
248: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
249: 		tx_fail = 1;
250: 		
251: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
252: 	}
253: 
254: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
255: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
256: 	#endif
257: 
258: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
261: 
262: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
263: 	{
264: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
265: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
266: 	}
267: 	else
268: 	{
269: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
270: 
271: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
272: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
273: 
274: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
275: 		{
276: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
277: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
278: 		}
279: 		else
280: 		{
281: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
282: 
283: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
284: 			{
285: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
293: 
294: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
295: 	{
296: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
297: 	}
298: 
299: rx_isr_data_xit:
300: 	
301: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
302: 	{
303: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
307: 
308: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
309: 
310: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
311: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
312: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
313: 	 */
314: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
315: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
316: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
317: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
318: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
319: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
320: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
321: 
322: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
323: 	{
324: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
325: 		{
326: 			/* trigger send! */
327: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
328: 		}
329: 	}
330: 	
331: 	return;
332: }

334: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
335: {
336: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
337: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
338: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
339: 
340: 	if (!invalid)
341: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
342: 	else
343: 	{
344: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
345: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
346: 	}
347: 
348: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
349: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
350: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
351: 	 */
352: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
353: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
354: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
355: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
356: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
357: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
358: 
359: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
360: 	{
361: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
362: 		{
363: 			/* trigger send! */
364: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
365: 		}
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	return;
369: }

371: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
372: {
373: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
374: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
375: 	
376: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
377: 	{
378: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
379: 	}
380: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
381: 	{
382: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
383: 	}
384: 	else
385: 	{
386: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
387: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
388: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
389: 		 */
390: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
391: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
392: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
393: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
394: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
395: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
396: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
397: 	}
398: 	
399: 	return;
400: }

402: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
403: {
404: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
405: 
406: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
407: 
408: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
409: 
410: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
411: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
412: 	{
413: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
414: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
415: 		return;
416: 	}
417: 
418: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
419: 
420: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
421: 	{
422: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
423: 	}
424: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
425: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
426: 	{
427: 		tx_fail = 1;
428: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
429: 	}
430: 	else
431: 	{
432: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
433: 	}
434: 
435: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
436: 	{
437: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
438: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
439: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
440: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
441: 	}
442: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
443: 	{
444: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
445: 		{
446: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
447: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
448: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
449: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
450: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
451: 		}
452: 	}
453: 
454: 	if (tx_fail)
455: 	{
456: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
457: 		{
458: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
459: 			{
460: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
461: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
462: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
463: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
464: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
465: 			}
466: 			else
467: 			{
468: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
469: 			}
470: 		}
471: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
472: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
473: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
474: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE &&
475: 			chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
476: 		{
477: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
478: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
479: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
480: 		}
481: 		else
482: 		{
483: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
484: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
485: 		}
486: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
487: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
488: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
489: 		return;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	/* try next Tx. */
493: 
494: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
495: 
496: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
497: 	{
498: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
499: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
500: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
501: 	}
502: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
503: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
504: 
505: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
506: 	{
507: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
511: 	{
512: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
513: 	}
514: 
515: 	return;
516: }

518: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
519: {
520: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
521: 	{
522: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
523: 	}
524: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
525: 	{
526: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
527: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
528: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
529: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
530: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
531: 	}
532: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
533: 	{
534: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
535: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
536: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
537: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
538: 	}
539: 	else
540: 	{
541: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
542: 		{
543: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
544: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
545: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
546: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
547: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
548: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
549: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
550: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
551: 		}
552: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
553: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
554: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
555: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
556: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
557: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
558: 		else
559: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
560: 	}
561: 
562: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
563: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
564: }

566: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
567: {
568: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
569: 
570: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
571: 		return BK_OK;
572: 
573: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
574: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
575: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
576: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
577: 
578: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
579: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
580: 
581: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
582: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
583: 	{
584: 		return BK_FAIL;
585: 	}
586: 
587: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
588: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
589: 	{
590: 		return ret_code;
591: 	}
592: 
593: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
594: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
595: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
596: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
597: 
598: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
599: 
600: 	return BK_OK;
601: }

603: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
604: {
605: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
606: 		return BK_OK;
607: 
608: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);
609: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, NULL);
610: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
611: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);

613: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);
614: 
615: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
616: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
617: 
618: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
619: 
620: 	return BK_OK;

623: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
624: {
625: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
626: 
627: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
628: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
629: 
630: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
631: 	{
632: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
633: 	}
634: 
635: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
636: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
637: 
638: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
639: 	{
640: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
641: 	}
642: 	else
643: 	{
644: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
645: 	}
646: 
647: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
648: 	{
649: 		return BK_FAIL;
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
653: 	{
654: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
655: 	}
656: 
657: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
658: 	{
659: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
660: 	}
661: 	else
662: 	{
663: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
664: 
665: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
666: 		{
667: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
668: 		}
669: 		else
670: 		{
671: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
672: 
673: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
674: 		}
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
678: 
679: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
680: 
681: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
682: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
683: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
684: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
685: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
686: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
687: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
688: 
689: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
690: 
691: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
692: 	{
693: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
694: 	}
695: 
696: 	return ret_val;
697: }

699: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
700: {
701: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
702: 
703: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
704: 	{
705: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
706: 		return BK_OK;
707: 	}
708: 
709: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
710: 
711: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
712: 
713: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
714: 
715: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
716: 
717: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
718: 	{
719: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	return ret_val;
723: }

725: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
726: {
727: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
728: 
729: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
730: 
731: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
732: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
733: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
734: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
735: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
736: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
737: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;
738: 
739: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
740: 
741: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
742: 
743: 	return ret_val;
744: }

746: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
747: {
748: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
749: 
750: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
751: 	{
752: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
753: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
754: 		return BK_OK;
755: 	}
756: 
757: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
758: 
759: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
760: 
761: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
762: 
763: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
764: 
765: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
766: 	{
767: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
768: 	}
769: 
770: 	return ret_val;
771: }

773: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
774: {
775: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
776: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
777: 	
778: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
779: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
780: 
781: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
782: 	{
783: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
784: 	}
785: 	else
786: 	{
787: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
788: 	}
789: 
790: 	wr_len = data_len;
791: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
792: 		wr_len = rem_len;
793: 
794: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
795: 	{
796: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
797: 	}
798: 	else
799: 	{
800: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
801: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
802: 
803: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
804: 		{
805: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
806: 		}
807: 		else
808: 		{
809: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
810: 
811: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
812: 		}
813: 	}
814: 
815: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
816: 
817: 	/* trigger send! */
818: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
819: 
820: 	return wr_len;
821: }

823: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
824: {
825: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
826: 
827: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
828: 		return 0;
829: 
830: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
831: 
832: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
833: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
834: 
835: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
836: 	{
837: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
838: 	}
839: 	else
840: 	{
841: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
842: 	}
843: 
844: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
845: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
846: 		rd_len = buf_len;
847: 
848: 	if(rd_len == 0)
849: 	{
850: 		return 0;
851: 	}
852: 
853: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
854: 	{
855: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
856: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
857: 	}
858: 	else
859: 	{
860: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
861: 
862: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
863: 		{
864: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
865: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
866: 		}
867: 		else
868: 		{
869: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
870: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
871: 			{
872: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
873: 			}
874: 
875: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
876: 		}
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
880: 
881: 	/* rts assert...... */
882: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
883: 	{
884: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
885: 		{
886: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
887: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
888: 		}
889: 	}
890: 
891: 	return rd_len;
892: 
893: }

525: static u8 * alloc_log_blk(u16 log_len, u16 *blk_tag)
526: {
527: 	u16    free_blk_id;
528: 	u8     queue_id;
529: 	u8     ovf_cnt_saved = 0;
530: 	free_queue_t * free_q;
531: 	u8     *       blk_buf = NULL;
532: 
533: 	u32  int_mask = shell_task_enter_critical();
534: 
535: 	for(queue_id = 0; queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue); queue_id++)
536: 	{
537: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
538: 
539: 		/*    queue ascending in blk_len.    */
540: 		if(free_q->blk_len < log_len)
541: 			continue;
542: 
543: 		if(free_q->free_blk_num > 0)
544: 		{
545: 			free_blk_id = free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_out_idx];
546: 
547: 			// free_q->list_out_idx = (free_q->list_out_idx + 1) % free_q->blk_num;
548: 			if((free_q->list_out_idx + 1) < free_q->blk_num)
549: 				free_q->list_out_idx++;
550: 			else
551: 				free_q->list_out_idx = 0;
552: 
553: 			free_q->free_blk_num--;
554: 
555: 			blk_buf = &free_q->log_buf[free_blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
556: 			*blk_tag = MAKE_BLOCK_TAG(free_blk_id, queue_id);
557: 
558: 			break;
559: 		}
560: 		else
561: 		{
562: 			if(ovf_cnt_saved == 0)
563: 			{
564: 				free_q->ovf_cnt++;
565: 				ovf_cnt_saved = 1;
566: 			}
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 
570: 	if(blk_buf == NULL)
571: 	{
572: 		shell_log_overflow++;
573: 	}
574: 	else
575: 	{
576: 		fault_hint_print = 0;
577: 		shell_log_count++;
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	shell_task_exit_critical(int_mask);
581: 
582: 	return blk_buf;
583: }

616: static int merge_log_data(u16 blk_tag, u16 data_len)
617: {
618: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
619: 	{
620: 		return 0;
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(blk_tag);
624: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(blk_tag);
625: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
626: 	{
627: 		return 0;
628: 	}
629: 
630: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
631: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
632: 
633: 	u8		* src_buf = NULL;
634: 
635: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
636: 	{
637: 		src_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
638: 	}
639: 	else
640: 		return 0;
641: 
642: 	u16    pre_in_idx;
643: 
644: 	if(pending_queue.list_in_idx > 0)
645: 		pre_in_idx = pending_queue.list_in_idx - 1;
646: 	else
647: 		pre_in_idx = SHELL_LOG_PEND_NUM - 1;
648: 
649: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
650: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
651: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
652: 	{
653: 		return 0;
654: 	}
655: 
656: 	u8		* dst_buf = NULL;
657: 	u16       buf_len = 0;
658: 
659: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
660: 
661: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
662: 	{
663: 		dst_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
664: 		buf_len = free_q->blk_len;
665: 	}
666: 	else
667: 		return 0;
668: 
669: 	u16       cur_len = pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len;
670: 
671: 	if((cur_len + data_len) > buf_len)  /* can be merged into one buffer? */
672: 		return 0;
673: 
674: 	memcpy(dst_buf + cur_len, src_buf, data_len);
675: 
676: 	pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len += data_len;
677: 
678: 	free_log_blk(blk_tag);  /* merged, free the log buffer. */
679: 
680: 	return 1;
681: }

722: /* call from cmd TX ISR. */
723: static int cmd_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
724: {
725: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
726: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
727: 
728: 	/* rsp ok ?? */
729: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID )    /* rsp. */
730: 	{
731: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
732: 
733: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
734: 		{
735: 			/* something wrong!!! */
736: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: in rsp.\r\n");
737: 		}
738: 
739: 		/* rsp compelete, rsp_buff can be used for next cmd/response. */
740: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.rsp_buf_semaphore);
741: 
742: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
743: 		if (s_ap_open_request)
744: 			set_shell_event(&shell_task_event, SHELL_EVENT_AP_SWITCH);
745: #endif
746: 
747: 		return 1;
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID )    /* cmd_ind. */
751: 	{
752: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
753: 
754: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
755: 		{
756: 			/* something wrong!!! */
757: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: indication.\r\n");
758: 		}
759: 
760: 		/* indication tx compelete, cmd_ind_buff can be used for next cmd_indication. */
761: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.ind_buf_semaphore);
762: 
763: 		return 1;
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
767: 	{
768: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
769: 
770: 		if (blk_id == 1)
771: 		{
772: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str)
773: 			{
774: 				/* something wrong!!! */
775: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
776: 			}
777: 
778: 			cmd_line_buf.cmd_ovf_hint = 0;
779: 
780: 			return 1;

813: /* call from log TX ISR. */
814: static int log_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
815: {
816: 	u16     block_tag;
817: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
818: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
819: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
820: 
821: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
822: 	{
823: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
824: 
825: 		if (blk_id == 0)
826: 		{
827: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_fault_str)
828: 			{
829: 				/* something wrong!!! */
830: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
831: 			}
832: 
833: 			return 1;
834: 		}
835: 	}
836: 
837: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))   /* from log busy queue. */
838: 	{
839: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
840: 
841: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
842: 
843: 		block_tag = log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_out_idx];
844: 
845: 		if( ( buf_tag != block_tag ) || (blk_id >= free_q->blk_num) ||
846: 			( (&free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len]) != pbuf) )
847: 		{
848: 			/* something wrong!!! */
849: 			/*        FAULT !!!!      */
850: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:%x,%x\r\n", buf_tag, block_tag);
851: 
852: 			return -1;
853: 		}
854: 
855: 		/* de-queue from busy queue. */
856: 		//log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
857: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
858: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx++;
859: 		else
860: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = 0;
861: 
862: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt++;
863: 
864: 		/* free buffer to queue. */
865: 		free_log_blk(block_tag);
866: 
867: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL) {
868: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&log_buf_semaphore);
869: 		}
870: 
871: 		return 1;
872: 	}
873: 
874: 	if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) {
875: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_pop_front();
876: 		free_list_push_front(node);
877: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL)
878: 			set_shell_event(&shell_log_event, SHELL_EVENT_DYM_FREE);
879: 		return 1;
880: 	}
881: 	return 0;
882: }

1056: /* call this in interrupt !* DISABLED *! context. */
1057: static void tx_req_process(void)
1058: {
1059: 	u8		*packet_buf = NULL;
1060: 	u16		block_tag;
1061: 	u16		log_len;
1062: 	u16		tx_ready;
1063: 	u16		blk_id;
1064: 	u8		queue_id;
1065: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
1066: 
1067: 	/* maybe tx_req is from tx_complete_callback, check if there any log in queue. */
1068: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
1069: 		return;
1070: 
1071: 	if(log_busy_queue.free_cnt == 0)
1072: 		return;
1073: 	
1074: 	tx_ready = 0;
1075: 
1076: 	log_dev->dev_drv->io_ctrl(log_dev, SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_STATUS, &tx_ready);
1077: 
1078: 	if(tx_ready == 0)
1079: 		return;
1080: 
1081: 	/**    ====     POP from pending queue     ====    **/
1082: 	pull_pending_queue(&block_tag, &log_len);
1083: 
1084: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(block_tag);
1085: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(block_tag);
1086: 
1087: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1088: 	{
1089: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
1090: 
1091: 		if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
1092: 		{
1093: 			packet_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
1094: 		}
1095: 	}
1096: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID)
1097: 	{
1098: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff;
1099: 
1100: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1101: 		{
1102: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1103: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1104: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1105: 			 * rsp will not be pushed into pending queue.
1106: 			 */
1107: 		}
1108: 	}
1109: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID)
1110: 	{
1111: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff;
1112: 
1113: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1114: 		{
1115: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1116: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1117: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1118: 			 * indication will not be pushed into pending queue.
1119: 			 */
1120: 		}
1121: 	}
1122: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID)
1123: 	{
1124: 		if(blk_id == 0)
1125: 		{
1126: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_fault_str;
1127: 		}
1128: 		else if(blk_id == 1)
1129: 		{
1130: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str;
1131: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1132: 			{
1133: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1134: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1135: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1136: 				 * cmd_hint will not be pushed into pending queue.
1137: 				 */
1138: 			}
1139: 		}
1140: 		else
1141: 		{
1142: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1143: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1144: 		}
1145: 	}
1146: 	else if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) 
1147: 	{
1148: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_switch();
1149: 		packet_buf = node->ptr;
1150: 	}
1151: 	#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
1152: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID)
1153: 	{
1154: 		if(blk_id == MBOX_RSP_BLK_ID)
1155: 		{
1156: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.rsp_buf.buf;
1157: 		}
1158: 		else if(blk_id == MBOX_IND_BLK_ID)
1159: 		{
1160: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.ind_buf.buf;
1161: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1162: 			{
1163: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1164: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1165: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1166: 				 * fwd_data will not be pushed into pending queue.
1167: 				 */
1168: 			}
1169: 		}
1170: 		else
1171: 		{
1172: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1173: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1174: 		}
1175: 	}
1176: 	#endif
1177: 	else
1178: 	{
1179: 		/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1180: 		shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req %x.\r\n", block_tag);
1181: 	}
1182: 
1183: 	if(packet_buf == NULL)
1184: 		return;
1185: 
1186: 	/* rom & rsp buff not enter busy-queue. */
1187: 	if(queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1188: 	{
1189: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt--;
1190: 		log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_in_idx] = block_tag;
1191: 		//log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
1192: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
1193: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx++;
1194: 		else
1195: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = 0;
1196: 	}
1197: 
1198: 	log_dev->dev_drv->write_async(log_dev, packet_buf, log_len, block_tag); /* send to log dev driver. */
1199: 	/* if driver return 0, should free log-block or not de-queue pending queue and try again. */
1200: 	/* if return 1, push log-block into busy queue is OK. */
1201: 
1202: 	return;
1203: }

1205: static void rx_ind_process(void)
1206: {
1207: 	u16   read_cnt, buf_len, echo_len;
1208: 	u16   i = 0;
1209: 	u8    cmd_rx_done = bFALSE, need_backspace = bFALSE;
1210: #if CONFIG_AT_DATA_MODE
1211: 	int   at_data_len = 0;
1212: #endif
1213: 	if(cmd_dev->dev_type == SHELL_DEV_MAILBOX)
1214: 	{
1215: 		buf_len = SHELL_RX_BUF_LEN;
1216: 	}
1217: 	else /* if(cmd_dev->dev_type == SHELL_DEV_UART) */
1218: 	{
1219: 		buf_len = 1;  /* for UART device, read one by one. */
1220: 	}
1221: 
1222: #if CONFIG_AT_DATA_MODE
1223: 	if(ATSVR_WK_DATA_HANDLE== get_atsvr_work_state())
1224: 	{
1225: 		at_data_len = get_data_len();
1226: 	}
1227: #endif
1228: 
1229: 	while(bTRUE)
1230: 	{
1231: 		u8  * rx_temp_buff = &cmd_line_buf.rx_buff[0];
1232: 
1233: 		read_cnt = cmd_dev->dev_drv->read(cmd_dev, rx_temp_buff, buf_len);
1234: 
1235: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
1236: 		if (s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_AP_CONSOLE ||
1237: 			s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_TO_CP_PENDING)
1238: 		{
1239: 			for (i = 0; i < read_cnt &&
1240: 				s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_AP_CONSOLE; i++)
1241: 			{
1242: 				u8 byte = rx_temp_buff[i];
1243: 
1244: 				if (s_ap_escape_pending)
1245: 				{
1246: 					s_ap_escape_pending = 0;
1247: 					if (byte == '.')
1248: 					{
1249: 						s_ap_close_request = 1;
1250: 						set_shell_event(&shell_task_event, SHELL_EVENT_AP_SWITCH);
1251: 						break;
1252: 					}
1253: 					if (ap_console_bridge_write((const u8 *)"\x1d", 1) != 1)
1254: 						break;
1255: 					s_ap_line_start = 0;
1256: 				}
1257: 
1258: 				if (s_ap_line_start && byte == 0x1d)
1259: 				{
1260: 					s_ap_escape_pending = 1;
1261: 					continue;
1262: 				}
1263: 
1264: 				if (ap_console_bridge_write(&byte, 1) != 1)
1265: 					break;
1266: 				s_ap_line_start = (byte == '\r' || byte == '\n');
1267: 			}
1268: 			if (read_cnt == buf_len && s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_AP_CONSOLE)
1269: 				set_shell_event(&shell_task_event, SHELL_EVENT_RX_IND);
1270: 			return;
1271: 		}
1272: 		if (s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_TO_AP_PENDING)
1273: 			return;
1274: #endif
1275: 
1276: 		echo_len = 0;
1277: 
1278: 		for(i = 0; i < read_cnt; i++)
1279: 		{
1280: 			if(cmd_line_buf.cur_cmd_type == CMD_TYPE_INVALID)
1281: 			{
1282: 				echo_len++;
1283: 
1284: 				if((rx_temp_buff[i] >= 0x20) && (rx_temp_buff[i] < 0x7f))
1285: 				{
1286: 					cmd_line_buf.cur_cmd_type = CMD_TYPE_TEXT;
1287: 
1288: 					cmd_line_buf.cmd_data_len = 0;
1289: 					cmd_line_buf.cmd_buff[cmd_line_buf.cmd_data_len] = rx_temp_buff[i];
1290: 					cmd_line_buf.cmd_data_len++;
1291: 
1292: 					continue;
1293: 				}
1294: 
1295: 				/* patch for BK_REG tool. */
1296: 				if(cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state == BKREG_WAIT_01)
1297: 				{
1298: 					if(rx_temp_buff[i] == 0x01)
1299: 						cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state = BKREG_WAIT_E0;
1300: 				}
1301: 				else if(cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state == BKREG_WAIT_E0)
1302: 				{
1303: 					if(rx_temp_buff[i] == 0xE0)
1304: 						cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state = BKREG_WAIT_FC;
1305: 					else if(rx_temp_buff[i] != 0x01)
1306: 						cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state = BKREG_WAIT_01;
1307: 				}
1308: 				else if(cmd_line_buf.bkreg_state == BKREG_WAIT_FC)
1309: 				{
1310: 					if(rx_temp_buff[i] == 0xFC)
1311: 					{
1312: 						cmd_line_buf.cur_cmd_type = CMD_TYPE_BKREG;
1313: 
1314: 						cmd_line_buf.cmd_buff[0] = 0x01;
1315: 						cmd_line_buf.cmd_buff[1] = 0xE0;
1316: 						cmd_line_buf.cmd_buff[2] = 0xFC;
1317: 
1318: 						cmd_line_buf.cmd_data_len = 3;
1319: 
1320: 						echo_len = 0;   // cann't echo anything.
1321: 
1322: 						continue;

77: /* Find the command 'name' in the cli commands table.
78: * If len is 0 then full match will be performed else upto len bytes.
79: * Returns: a pointer to the corresponding cli_command struct or NULL.
80: */
81: const struct cli_command *lookup_command(char *name, int len)
82: {
83: 	int i = 0;
84: 	int n = 0;
85: 
86: 	while (i < MAX_COMMANDS && n < pCli->num_commands) {
87: 		if (pCli->commands[i]->name == NULL) {
88: 			i++;
89: 			continue;
90: 		}
91: 
92: 		/* See if partial or full match is expected */
93: 		if (len != 0) {
94: 			if (!os_strncmp(pCli->commands[i]->name, name, len)) {
95: 				s_running_command_index = i;
96: 				return pCli->commands[i];
97: 			}
98: 		} else {
99: 			if (!os_strcmp(pCli->commands[i]->name, name)) {
100: 				s_running_command_index = i;
101: 				return pCli->commands[i];
102: 			}
103: 		}
104: 
105: 		i++;
106: 		n++;
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	return NULL;
110: }

288: /* Parse input line and locate arguments (if any), keeping count of the number
289: * of arguments and their locations.  Look up and call the corresponding cli
290: * function if one is found and pass it the argv array.
291: *
292: * Returns: 0 on success: the input line contained at least a function name and
293: *          that function exists and was called.
294: *          1 on lookup failure: there is no corresponding function for the
295: *          input line.
296: *          2 on invalid syntax: the arguments list couldn't be parsed
297: */
298: int handle_shell_input2(char *inbuf, int in_buf_size, char * outbuf, int out_buf_size)
299: {
300: #if CONFIG_CLI
301: 
302: 	struct {
303: 		unsigned inArg: 1;
304: 		unsigned inQuote: 1;
305: 		unsigned done: 1;
306: 		unsigned limQ : 1;
307: 		unsigned isD : 2;
308: 	} stat;
309: 	char *argv[24];
310: 	int argc = 0;
311: 	int i = 0;
312: 	const struct cli_command *command = NULL;
313: 	const char *p;
314: 
315: 	os_memset((void *)&argv, 0, sizeof(argv));
316: 	os_memset(&stat, 0, sizeof(stat));
317: 
318: 	if(outbuf != NULL)
319: 		os_memset(outbuf, 0, out_buf_size);
320: 
321: 	if (inbuf[i] == '\0')
322: 		return 0;
323: 
324: 	int fwd_pos = is_forward_cmd(inbuf, in_buf_size);
325: 	if(fwd_pos >= 0) {
326: 		argc = 2;
327: 		argv[0] = &inbuf[fwd_pos];
328: 		argv[1] = &inbuf[fwd_pos + 7];
329: 		inbuf[fwd_pos + 6] = '\0';
330: 	} else {
331: 		do {
332: 			switch (inbuf[i]) {
333: 			case '\0':
334: 				if (((argc == 0)||(stat.isD == 1))||(stat.limQ)||(stat.inQuote))
335: 				{
336: 					if(outbuf != NULL)
337: 						strncpy(&outbuf[0], "syntax error\r\n", out_buf_size - 1);
338: 					return 2;
339: 				}
340: 				stat.done = 1;
341: 				break;
342: 
343: 			case '"':
344: 				if (i > 0 && inbuf[i - 1] == '\\' && stat.inArg) {
345: 					os_memcpy(&inbuf[i - 1], &inbuf[i],
346: 							os_strlen(&inbuf[i]) + 1);
347: 					--i;
348: 					break;
349: 				}
350: 				if (!stat.inQuote && stat.inArg)
351: 					break;
352: 				if (stat.inQuote && !stat.inArg)
353: 				{
354: 					if(outbuf != NULL)
355: 						strncpy(&outbuf[0], "syntax error\r\n", out_buf_size - 1);
356: 					return 2;
357: 				}
358: 
359: 				if (!stat.inQuote && !stat.inArg) {
360: 					stat.inArg = 1;
361: 					stat.inQuote = 1;
362: 					argc++;
363: 					argv[argc - 1] = &inbuf[i + 1];
364: 				} else if (stat.inQuote && stat.inArg) {
365: 					stat.inArg = 0;
366: 					stat.inQuote = 0;
367: 					inbuf[i] = '\0';
368: 				}
369: 				break;
370: 
371: 			case ' ':
372: 				if (i > 0 && inbuf[i - 1] == '\\' && stat.inArg) {
373: 					os_memcpy(&inbuf[i - 1], &inbuf[i],
374: 							os_strlen(&inbuf[i]) + 1);
375: 					--i;

382: 				break;

384: 			case '=':

393: 					return 2;
394: 				}
395: 				break;
396: 	#if 0
397: 			case ',':

407: 					stat.limQ = 1;
408: 				}

424: 	}

426: 	if (stat.inQuote)

428: 		 if(outbuf != NULL)
429: 		 	strncpy(&outbuf[0], "syntax error\r\n", out_buf_size - 1);
430: 		return 2;

433: 	if (argc < 1)

435: 		if(outbuf != NULL)

440: 	/*

442: 	* compare commands before first dot.
443: 	*/
444: 	i = ((p = os_strchr(argv[0], '.')) == NULL) ? 0 :

569: /* Parse input line and locate arguments (if any), keeping count of the number
570: * of arguments and their locations.  Look up and call the corresponding cli
571: * function if one is found and pass it the argv array.
572: *
573: * Returns: 0 on success: the input line contained at least a function name and
574: *          that function exists and was called.
575: *          1 on lookup failure: there is no corresponding function for the
576: *          input line.
577: *          2 on invalid syntax: the arguments list couldn't be parsed
578: */
579: static int handle_input(char *inbuf)
580: {
581: 	struct {
582: 		unsigned inArg: 1;
583: 		unsigned inQuote: 1;
584: 		unsigned done: 1;
585: 		unsigned limQ : 1;
586: 		unsigned isD : 2;
587: 	} stat;
588: 	char *argv[24];
589: 	int argc = 0;
590: 	int i = 0;
591: 	const struct cli_command *command = NULL;
592: 	const char *p;
593: 
594: 	os_memset((void *)&argv, 0, sizeof(argv));
595: 	os_memset(&stat, 0, sizeof(stat));
596: 
597: 	if (inbuf[i] == '\0')
598: 		return 0;
599: 
600: 	do {
601: 		switch (inbuf[i]) {
602: 		case '\0':
603: 			if (((argc == 0)||(stat.isD == 1))||(stat.limQ)||(stat.inQuote))
604: 				return 2;
605: 			stat.done = 1;
606: 			break;
607: 
608: 		case '"':
609: 			if (i > 0 && inbuf[i - 1] == '\\' && stat.inArg) {
610: 				os_memcpy(&inbuf[i - 1], &inbuf[i],
611: 						  os_strlen(&inbuf[i]) + 1);
612: 				--i;
613: 				break;
614: 			}
615: 			if (!stat.inQuote && stat.inArg)
616: 				break;
617: 			if (stat.inQuote && !stat.inArg)
618: 				return 2;
619: 
620: 			if (!stat.inQuote && !stat.inArg) {
621: 				stat.inArg = 1;
622: 				stat.inQuote = 1;
623: 				argc++;
624: 				argv[argc - 1] = &inbuf[i + 1];
625: 			} else if (stat.inQuote && stat.inArg) {
626: 				stat.inArg = 0;
627: 				stat.inQuote = 0;
628: 				inbuf[i] = '\0';
629: 			}
630: 			break;
631: 
632: 		case ' ':
633: 			if (i > 0 && inbuf[i - 1] == '\\' && stat.inArg) {
634: 				os_memcpy(&inbuf[i - 1], &inbuf[i],
635: 						  os_strlen(&inbuf[i]) + 1);
636: 				--i;
637: 				break;
638: 			}
639: 			if (!stat.inQuote && stat.inArg) {
640: 				stat.inArg = 0;
641: 				inbuf[i] = '\0';
642: 			}
643: 			break;
644: 
645:         case '=':
646:             if(argc == 1) {
647:                 inbuf[i] = '\0';
648:                 stat.inArg = 0;
649:                 stat.isD = 1;
650:             }
651:             else if(argc == 0){
652:                 BK_LOGD(NULL,"The data does not conform to the regulations %d\r\n",__LINE__);
653:                 return 2;
654:             }
655:             break;
656: 
657:         case ',':
658:             if((stat.isD == 1)&&(argc == 1))  ///=,
659:             {
660:                 BK_LOGD(NULL,"The data does not conform to the regulations %d\r\n",__LINE__);
661:                 return 2;
662:             }
663:             if(!stat.inQuote && stat.inArg) {
664:                 stat.inArg = 0;
665:                 inbuf[i] = '\0';
666:                 stat.limQ = 1;
667:             }
668:             break;
669: 
670: 		default:
671: 			if (!stat.inArg) {
672: 				stat.inArg = 1;
673: 				argc++;
674: 				argv[argc - 1] = &inbuf[i];
675:                 stat.limQ = 0;
676:                 if(stat.isD == 1) {
677:                     stat.isD = 2;
678:                 }
679: 			}
680: 			break;
681: 		}
682: 	} while (!stat.done && ++i < INBUF_SIZE);
683: 
684: 	if (stat.inQuote)
685: 		return 2;
686: 
687: 	if (argc < 1)
688: 		return 0;
689: 
690: 	if (!pCli->echo_disabled)
691: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"\r\n");
692: 
693: 	/*
694: 	* Some comamands can allow extensions like foo.a, foo.b and hence
695: 	* compare commands before first dot.
696: 	*/
697: 	i = ((p = os_strchr(argv[0], '.')) == NULL) ? 0 :
698: 		(p - argv[0]);
699: 	command = lookup_command(argv[0], i);
700: 	if (command == NULL)
701: 		return 1;
702: 
703: 	os_memset(pCli->outbuf, 0, OUTBUF_SIZE);
704: 	cli_putstr("\r\n");
705: 
706: #if CONFIG_STA_PS
707: 	/*if cmd,exit dtim ps*/
708: 	if (os_strncmp(command->name, "ps", 2)) {
709: 	}
710: #endif
711: 
712: #if CFG_CLI_DEBUG
713: 	s_running_status |= CLI_COMMAND_IS_RUNNING;
714: 	command->function((char *)pCli->outbuf, OUTBUF_SIZE, argc, argv);
715: 	s_running_status &= ~CLI_COMMAND_IS_RUNNING;
716: #else
717: 	command->function(pCli->outbuf, OUTBUF_SIZE, argc, argv);
718: #endif
719: 	cli_putstr((char *)pCli->outbuf);
720: 	return 0;
721: }

723: /* Perform basic tab-completion on the input buffer by string-matching the
724: * current input line against the cli functions table.  The current input line
725: * is assumed to be NULL-terminated. */
726: static void tab_complete(char *inbuf, unsigned int *bp)
727: {
728: 	int i, n, m;
729: 	const char *fm = NULL;
730: 
731: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"\r\n");
732: 
733: 	/* show matching commands */
734: 	for (i = 0, n = 0, m = 0; i < MAX_COMMANDS && n < pCli->num_commands;
735: 		 i++) {
736: 		if (pCli->commands[i]->name != NULL) {
737: 			if (!os_strncmp(inbuf, pCli->commands[i]->name, *bp)) {
738: 				m++;
739: 				if (m == 1)
740: 					fm = pCli->commands[i]->name;
741: 				else if (m == 2)
742: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"%s %s ", fm,
743: 							  pCli->commands[i]->name);
744: 				else
745: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"%s ",
746: 							  pCli->commands[i]->name);
747: 			}
748: 			n++;
749: 		}
750: 	}
751: 
752: 	/* there's only one match, so complete the line */
753: 	if (m == 1 && fm) {
754: 		n = os_strlen(fm) - *bp;
755: 		if (*bp + n < INBUF_SIZE) {
756: 			os_memcpy(inbuf + *bp, fm + *bp, n);
757: 			*bp += n;
758: 			inbuf[(*bp)++] = ' ';
759: 			inbuf[*bp] = '\0';
760: 		}
761: 	}
762: 
763: 	/* just redraw input line */
764: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"%s%s", PROMPT, inbuf);
765: }
766: /* Get an input line.
767: *
768: * Returns: 1 if there is input, 0 if the line should be ignored. */
769: static int get_input(char *inbuf, unsigned int *bp)
770: {
771: 	if (inbuf == NULL) {
772: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"inbuf_null\r\n");
773: 		return 0;
774: 	}
775: 
776: 	while (cli_getchar(&inbuf[*bp]) == 1) {
777: #if CONFIG_BKREG
778: 		if ((0x01U == (UINT8)inbuf[*bp]) && (*bp == 0)) {
779: 			(*bp)++;
780: 			continue;
781: 		} else if ((0xe0U == (UINT8)inbuf[*bp]) && (*bp == 1)) {
782: 			(*bp)++;
783: 			continue;
784: 		} else if ((0xfcU == (UINT8)inbuf[*bp]) && (*bp == 2)) {
785: 			(*bp)++;
786: 			continue;
787: 		} else {
788: 			if ((0x01U == (UINT8)inbuf[0])
789: 				&& (0xe0U == (UINT8)inbuf[1])
790: 				&& (0xfcU == (UINT8)inbuf[2])
791: 				&& (*bp == 3)) {
792: 				uint8_t ch = inbuf[*bp];
793: 				uint8_t left = ch, len = 4 + (uint8_t)ch;
794: 				inbuf[*bp] = ch;
795: 				(*bp)++;
796: 
797: 				if (ch >= INBUF_SIZE) {
798: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"Error: input buffer overflow\r\n");
799: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,PROMPT);
800: 					*bp = 0;
801: 					return 0;
802: 				}
803: 
804: 				while (left--) {
805: 					if (0 == cli_getchar((char *)&ch))
806: 						break;
807: 
808: 					inbuf[*bp] = ch;
809: 					(*bp)++;
810: 				}
811: 
812: 				bkreg_run_command(inbuf, len);
813: 				os_memset(inbuf, 0, len);
814: 				*bp = 0;
815: 				continue;
816: 			}
817: 		}
818: #endif
819: 		/* find first invalid input data, discard input data more than 0x7f */
820: 		if ((uint8_t)inbuf[0] > 0x7f) {
821: 			continue;
822: 		}
823: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == RET_CHAR)
824: 			continue;
825: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == END_CHAR) {   /* end of input line */
826: 			inbuf[*bp] = '\0';
827: 			*bp = 0;
828: 			return 1;
829: 		}
830: 
831: 		if ((inbuf[*bp] == 0x08) || /* backspace */
832: 			(inbuf[*bp] == 0x7f)) { /* DEL */
833: 			if (*bp > 0) {
834: 				(*bp)--;
835: 				if (!pCli->echo_disabled)
836: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"%c %c", 0x08, 0x08);
837: 			}
838: 			continue;
839: 		}
840: 
841: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == '\t') {
842: 			inbuf[*bp] = '\0';
843: 			tab_complete(inbuf, bp);
844: 			continue;
845: 		}
846: 
847: 		if (!pCli->echo_disabled)
848: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"%c", inbuf[*bp]);
849: 
850: 		(*bp)++;
851: 		if (*bp >= INBUF_SIZE) {
852: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"Error: input buffer overflow\r\n");
853: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,PROMPT);
854: 			*bp = 0;
855: 			return 0;
856: 		}
857: 	}
858: 
859: 	return 0;
860: }

1300: 		}
1301: 		pCli->commands[pCli->num_commands++] = command;
1302: 		return 0;
1303: 	}
1304:

1306: 	#else
1307: 	return 0;
1308: 	#endif // CONFIG_CLI

1311: int cli_unregister_command(const struct cli_command *command)
1312: {
1313: 	int i;
1314: 	if (!command->name || !command->function)
1315: 		return 1;
1316: 
1317: 	for (i = 0; i < pCli->num_commands; i++) {
1318: 		if (pCli->commands[i] == command) {
1319: 			pCli->num_commands--;
1320: 			int remaining_cmds = pCli->num_commands - i;
1321: 			if (remaining_cmds > 0) {
1322: 				os_memmove(&pCli->commands[i], &pCli->commands[i + 1],
1323: 						   (remaining_cmds *
1324: 							sizeof(struct cli_command *)));
1325: 			}
1326: 			pCli->commands[pCli->num_commands] = NULL;
1327: 			return 0;
1328: 		}
1329: 	}
1330: 
1331: 	return 1;
1332: }

8: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN     3

10: 
11: 
12: #define MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START     0
13: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN)
14: #define MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN)
15: 
16: //struct mbox0_fifo_cfg_t:
17: #define MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE   \
18: {   \
19: 	{MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN}, \
20: 	{MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN}, \
21: 	{MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_LEN}, \
22: }
23: 
24: 
25: static mbox0_dev_t       mbox0_dev;
26: static u8                mbox0_init = 0;
27: 
28: static const mbox0_fifo_cfg_t  fifo_cfg[] = MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE;
29: 	
30: static int mbox0_drv_recieve_message(mbox0_message_t* message)
31: {
32: 	return mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_recv(&mbox0_dev.hal, message);
33: }
34: 
35: static void mbox0_drv_isr_handler(void)
36: {
37: 	uint32_t int_status;
38: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
39: 	mbox0_message_t message;
40: 
41: 	int_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_int_status(&mbox0_dev.hal);
42: 
43: 	if(int_status == 0)
44: 		return;
45: 
46: 	do
47: 	{
48: 		fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
49: 		
50: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
51: 		{
52: 			if (mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback &&
53: 				!mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback())
54: 				break;
55: 
56: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
57: 
58: 			if(message.data[1] != 0)  /* message data len is not 0. */
59: 			{
60: 				if(mbox0_dev.rx_callback != NULL)
61: 					mbox0_dev.rx_callback(&message);
62: 			}
63: 			else
64: 			{
65: 				#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
66: 				extern void crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(uint8_t src_core, uint32_t cmd);
67: 				
68: 				crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(message.src_cpu, message.data[0]);
69: 				#endif
70: 			}
71: 		}
72: 		else
73: 		{
74: 			break;
75: 		}
76: 	} while(1);
77: 	
78: }
79: 
80: int mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(uint32_t dest_cpu, uint32_t *fifo_status)
81: {
82: 	if((dest_cpu >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM) || (fifo_status == NULL))
83: 	{
84: 		return MBOX0_HAL_SW_PARAM_ERR;
85: 	}
86: 
87: 	*fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[dest_cpu]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
88: 
89: 	return MBOX0_HAL_OK;
90: }
91: 
92: int mbox0_drv_send_message(mbox0_message_t* message)
93: {
94: 	return mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_send(&mbox0_dev.hal, message);
95: }
96: 
97: int mbox0_drv_callback_register(mbox0_rx_callback_t callback)
98: {
99: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = callback;
100: 
101: 	return 0;
102: }
103: 
104: int mbox0_drv_ready_callback_register(mbox0_rx_ready_callback_t callback)
105: {
106: 	mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback = callback;
107: 	return 0;
108: }
109: 
110: int mbox0_init_on_current_core(int id)
111: {
112: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
113: 
114: 	if(CPU0_CORE_ID == id)
115: 	{
116: 		mbox0_hal_dev_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be initialized by CPU0. */
117: 		mbox0_hal_set_reg_0x2_chn_pro_disable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1); /* channel unprotect */
118: 
119: 		for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(fifo_cfg); i++)
120: 			mbox0_dev.chn_drv[i]->chn_cfg_fifo(&mbox0_dev.hal, fifo_cfg[i].start, fifo_cfg[i].len);
121: 	}
122: 
123: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1);
124: 
125: 	/* clear/empty RX FIFO. */
126: 	while(1)
127: 	{
128: 		mbox0_message_t message;
129: 
130: 		uint32_t fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
131: 		
132: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
133: 		{
134: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
135: 		}
136: 		else
137: 		{
138: 			break;
139: 		}
140: 	}
141: 
142: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
143: 	/* enable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
144: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(id, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
145: #else
146: 	sys_drv_int_group2_enable(1 << (int_src - 32));
147: #endif
148: 
149: 	return 0;
150: }
151: 
152: int mbox0_drv_init(void)
153: {
154: 	if(mbox0_init == 1)
155: 		return 0;
156: 
157: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[0] = &hal_chn0_drv;
158: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[1] = &hal_chn1_drv;
159: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[2] = &hal_chn2_drv;
160: 
161: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = NULL;
162: 	mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback = NULL;
163: 
164: 	mbox0_hal_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);
165: 
166: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
167: 
168: 	bk_int_isr_register(int_src, mbox0_drv_isr_handler, NULL);
169: 
170: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
171: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU0_CORE_ID);
172: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU1_CORE_ID);
173: #else
174: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(SELF_CHNL);
175: #endif
176: 
177: 	mbox0_init = 1;
178: 
179: 	return 0;
180: }
181: 
182: int mbox0_drv_deinit(void)
183: {
184: 	if(mbox0_init == 0)
185: 		return 0;
186: 
187: 	uint8_t int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
188: 
189: 	// sys_drv_int_group2_disable(1 << (int_src - 32));
190: 
191: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
192: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
193: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_disable(CPU0_CORE_ID, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
194: 	
195: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
196: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_disable(CPU1_CORE_ID, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
197: 
198: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[CPU0_CORE_ID]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
199: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[CPU1_CORE_ID]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
200: #else
201: 	sys_drv_int_group2_disable(1 << (int_src - 32));
202: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
203: #endif
204: 
205: 	bk_int_isr_unregister(int_src);
206: 
207: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
208: 	mbox0_hal_dev_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be de-initialized by CPU0. */
209: #else
210: 	if(SELF_CHNL == 0)
211: 		mbox0_hal_dev_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be de-initialized by CPU0. */
212: #endif
213: 
214: 	mbox0_hal_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);
215: 	
216: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = NULL;
217: 	mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback = NULL;
218: 
219: 	mbox0_init = 0;
220: 
221: 	return 0;
222: }

113: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
114: {
115: 	u32   cur_time;
116: 
117: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
118: 
119: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
120: 	{
121: 		return 0;
122: 	}
123: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
124: 	{
125: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
126: 		return 0;
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
130: 	{
131: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
132: 	}
133: 	else
134: 	{
135: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
139: 	{
140: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
141: 		return 0;
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
145: 	{
146: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
147: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
148: 		return 0;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
152: 	{
153: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
154: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
155: 		return 0;
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	return 1;
159: }

219: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
220: {
221: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
222: 	u32    events;
223: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
224: 
225: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
226: 
227: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
228: 
229: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
230: 	{
231: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
232: 		return;
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	while(1)
236: 	{
237: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
238: 
239: 		if(events == 0)
240: 		{
241: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
242: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
243: 		}
244: 
245: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
246: 		{
247: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
248: 			{
249: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 		
253: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
254: 		{
255: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
256: 
257: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
258: 			{
259: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
260: 				
261: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
262: 				{
263: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
264: 					{
265: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
266: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
267: 					}
268: 				}
269: 				else
270: 				{
271: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
272: 					{
273: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
274: 						// restart_cpu_x();
275: 						break;
276: 					}
277: 					else
278: 					{
279: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
280: 					}
281: 				}
282: 
283: 				retry_cnt++;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
287: 		}
288: 		
289: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
290: 		{
291: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
292: 			{
293: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
294: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
295: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
296: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
297: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
298: 			}
299: 		}
300: 
301: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
302: 		{
303: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
304: 		}
305: 		else
306: 		{
307: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
308: 		}
309: 	}
310: }

50: typedef union

52: 	struct
53: 	{
54: 		mb_chnl_hdr_t	chnl_hdr;
55: 		void *	cmd_buff;
56: 		u16		cmd_data_len;
57: 	};

59: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd;

74: typedef u32 (* ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t)(void * chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf);
75: 
76: typedef struct
77: {
78: 	/* chnl data */
79: 	u8					chnl_inited;
80: 	u8					chnl_id;
81: 	beken_semaphore_t	chnl_sema;
82: 
83: 	/* tx cmd data */
84: 	beken_semaphore_t	rsp_sema;
85: 	u8			*	tx_xchg_buff;
86: 	u8				tx_cmd;
87: 	volatile u8		tx_cmd_in_process;
88: 	volatile u8		tx_cmd_failed;
89: 	u32				rsp_buf[IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX / sizeof(u32)];
90: 	u16				rsp_len;
91: 
92: 	/* rx cmd data */
93: 	ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t	rx_cmd_handler;
94: 	u8			*	rx_xchg_buff;
95: 	u8				rx_cmd;
96: 	volatile u8		rx_cmd_in_process;
97: 	u32				cmd_buf[IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX / sizeof(u32)];
98: 	u16				cmd_len;
99: } ipc_chnl_cb_t;
