103: static SPINLOCK_SECTION volatile spinlock_t mb_ipc_spin_lock = SPIN_LOCK_INIT;
104: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
105: static inline uint32_t ipc_enter_critical()
106: {
107: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
108: 
109: #ifdef CONFIG_SOC_SMP
110: 	spin_lock(&mb_ipc_spin_lock);
111: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
112: 
113: 	return flags;
114: }
115: 
116: static inline void ipc_exit_critical(uint32_t flags)
117: {
118: #ifdef CONFIG_SOC_SMP
119: 	spin_unlock(&mb_ipc_spin_lock);
120: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
121: 
122: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
123: }
124: 
125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				__DMB();
168: 				
169: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
170: 
171: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
172: 			}
173: 			else
174: 			{
175: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
180: 
181: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
182: 
183: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
185: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
186: 
187: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
188: 
189: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
190: 	}
191: 	else
192: 	{
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
194: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
195: 
196: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
197: 
198: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
199: 		{
200: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
201: 		}
202: 		else
203: 		{
204: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
205: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
206: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
207: 			{
208: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
209: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
210: 				#endif
211: 				__DMB();
212: 				
213: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 
215: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
216: 			}
217: 			else
218: 			{
219: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
220: 			}
221: 
222: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
226: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
227: 	}
228: 
229: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
230: 
231: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
232: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
233: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
234: 	 */
235: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
236: 
237: 	return;
238: 
239: }

241: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
242: {
243: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
244: 	{
245: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
246: 			return;
247: 
248: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
249: 
250: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
251: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
252: 		{
253: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
254: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
255: 
256: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
257: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
258: 		}
259: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
260: 		{
261: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
262: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
263: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
264: 
265: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
266: 
267: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
268: 
269: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
270: 			{
271: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
272: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
273: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
274: 			}
275: 			else
276: 			{
277: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
278: 				{
279: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
280: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
281: 					#endif
282: 					__DMB();
283: 
284: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
285: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
286: 				}
287: 				else
288: 				{
289: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 			
293: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
294: 		}
295: 		else
296: 		{
297: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
298: 		}
299: 
300: 		return;
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	/*
304: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
305: 	 */
306: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
307: 
308: 	return;
309: 
310: }

312: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
313: {
314: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
315: 
316: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
317: 		return BK_OK;
318: 
319: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
320: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
321: 
322: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
323: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
324: 
325: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
326: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
327: 	{
328: 		return BK_FAIL;
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
332: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
333: 	{
334: 		return ret_code;
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
338: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
339: 	{
340: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
341: 
342: 		return ret_code;
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
346: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
347: 	{
348: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
349: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
350: 
351: 		return ret_code;
352: 	}
353: 
354: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
355: 
356: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
357: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
358: 
359: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
360: 
361: 	return BK_OK;
362: }

364: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
365: {
366: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
367: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
368: 
369: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
370: 		ipc_init();
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
374: 		return BK_FAIL;
375: 
376: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
377: 
378: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
379: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
380: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
381: 
382: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
383: 
384: 	do
385: 	{
386: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
387: 		{
388: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
389: 			break;
390: 		}
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
393: 			cmd_len = 0;
394: 
395: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
396: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
397: 
398: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
399: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
400: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
401: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
402: 
403: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
404: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
405: 		{
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
410: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
411: 		{
412: 			break;
413: 		}
414: 
415: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
416: 
417: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
430: 		{
431: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
432: 			break;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
436: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
437: 
438: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
439: 
440: 	}while(0);
441: 
442: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
443: 
444: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
445: 
446: 	return ret_val;
447: 
448: }

515: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
516: {
517: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
518: 
519: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
521: 
522: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
523: 
524: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
525: 
526: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
527: 	{
528: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
529: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
530: 			{
531: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
532: 
533: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
534: 
535: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
536: 				{
537: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555: 
556: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 				
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
566: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
571: 			{
572: 				// return PS flag to caller.
573: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
574: 
575: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
576: 
577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
578: 
579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
580: 			}
581: 			break;
582: 
583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{
586: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
587: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
588: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
589: 			}
590: 			break;
591: 
592: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
593: 			{
594: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
595: 				bk_usb_cdc_close();
596: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
597: 			}
598: 			break;
599: 		case IPC_CPU0_STOP_USB_CDC:
600: 			{
601: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
602: 				bk_usb_cdc_stop();
603: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
604: 			}
605: 			break;
606: 
607: 		case IPC_CPU0_INIT_USB_CDC_PARAM:
608: 			{
609: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
610: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
611: 				bk_usb_cdc_init(p_cdc_data);
612: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
613: 			}
614: 			break;
615: 
616: 		case IPC_CPU0_SET_USB_CDC_CMD:
617: 			{
618: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
619: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
620: 				bk_cdc_acm_bulkout(p_cdc_data);
621: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
622: 			}
623: 			break;
624: #endif
625: 
626: #if (USB_CDC_CP0_IPC)
627: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPLOAD_USB_CDC_DATA:
628: 			{
629: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
630: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
631: 				if (p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb) {
632: 					p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb();
633: 				}
634: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
635: 			}
636: 			break;
637: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPDATE_USB_CDC_STATE:
638: 			{
639: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
640: 				extern void (*usb_cdc_state_cb)(bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status);
641: 				bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status = (bk_cdc_hub_status *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
642: 				if (usb_cdc_state_cb) {
643: 					usb_cdc_state_cb(cdc_status);
644: 				}
645: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
646: 			}
647: 			break;
648: #endif
649: 
650: 
651: 		case IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION:		// cpu1 indication, power up successfully.
652: 			{
653: 				/* no params. */
654: 				/* inform modules who care CPU1 state. */
655: 				u8   on_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
656: 				mb_ipc_power_on_notify(on_cpu_id);
657: 				if (on_cpu_id == MAILBOX_CPU1)
658: 					ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC, true);
659: 				
660: 				/* no returns. */
661: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
662: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
663: 			}
664: 			break;
665: 
666: 		case IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION:	// cpu1 indication, alive indication.
667: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
668: 			{
669: 				// contains any data?
670: 				// u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
671: 
672: 				// save the param.
673: 				
674: 				u8   hb_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
675: 				mb_ipc_heartbeat_notify(hb_cpu_id);
676: 
677: 			}
678: 
679: 			/* succeeded anyway but no returns. */
680: 			ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
681: 			result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
682: 			break;
683: 
684: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_BEGIN:		// cpu1 indication, dump begin.
685: 			{
686: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
687: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
688: 
689:                 g_ap_dump_flag = 1;
690: 
691:                 /* if ap dump ,then cp shoule disable its most interruptions */
692:                 sys_drv_int_disable(0xFFFE7FE7);
693:                 sys_drv_int_group2_disable(0x7FFFFFFF);
694: 
695: 				u8   dump_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
696: 				mb_ipc_dump_notify(dump_cpu_id, 1);
697: 				/* no params, no returns. */
698: 				#if (CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG)
699: 				shell_set_log_cpu(dump_cpu_id);
700: 				#endif
701: 			}
702: 			break;
703: 		
704: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_END:		// cpu1 indication, dump end.
705: 			{
706: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;

329: static void pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
330: {
331: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
332: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
333: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
334: 	{
335: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
336: 		{
337: boot_cp1:
338: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
339: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
340: 			#endif
341:             bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
342: 
343: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
344: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
345: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
346: 			reset_forward_log_status();
347: 			#endif
348: 
349:             start_cpu1_core();
350: 
351: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
352: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
353: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
354: 			{
355: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
356: 				{
357: 					break;
358: 				}
359: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
360: 			}
361: 
362: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
363: 			{
364: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"cp0 boot cp1[%d] time out, boot cp1 fail!!!\r\n",s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count);
365: 
366: 				/*Reset psram*/
367: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
368: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
369: 
370: 				s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count++;
371: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count < PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
372: 				{
373: 					goto boot_cp1;
374: 				}
375: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count == PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
376: 				{
377: 					#if CONFIG_WDT_EN
378: 					bk_wdt_force_reboot();//try 3 times, if fail ,reboot.
379: 					#endif
380: 				}
381: 			}
382: 		}
383: 	}
384: }

468:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
469:     {
470: 		//bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1,PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
471: 		//bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
472: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
473: 		s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state |= 0x1 << (module);
474: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
475: 		pm_module_bootup_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
476:     }
477:     else //power down
478:     {
479: 		if(s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state&(0x1 << (module)))
480: 		{
481: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
482: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << (module));
483: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
484: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state)
485: 			{
486: 				s_pm_cp1_closing = 1;
487: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d close 0x%llx %d\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,s_pm_cp1_boot_ready);
488: 				pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,0,0,0);
489: 				//pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
490: 			}

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
14: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
15: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |

253: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
254: 
255: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 已收到成功 transport ACK、
256: `bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，`ap_console open`才允许进入；这是保守的
257: "MBUART 可写 + peer STATE ready"门禁，不代表 IPC power-up 和 PWC boot-ready 已由本桥
258: 独立验证。使用方式：
259: 
260: ```text
261: ap_console status
262: ap_console open
263: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
264: <at line start press Ctrl-], then .>
265: ap_console status
266: ```
267: 
268: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
269: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出转义只在行首识别，链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
270: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
271: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。
272:

192: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
193: {
194:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
195:   int ret;
196: 
197:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
198:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
199:    */
200: 
201:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
202:     {
203:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
204:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
205:         {
206:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
207:           break;
208:         }
209: 
210:       desc->used = false;
211:     }
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
216:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
217:         {
218:           break;
219:         }
220: 
221:       desc->used = false;
222:     }
223: }

226: {
227:   (void)irq;
228:   (void)context;
229:   (void)arg;
230: 
231:   mbox_clear_errors();
232: 
233:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
234:     {
235:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
236:       uint32_t address;
237:       uint32_t length;
238:       uint8_t source;
239: 
240:       mbox_process_desc();
241:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
242:       if (desc == NULL)
243:         {
244:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
245:           break;
246:         }
247: 
248:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
249:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
250:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
251:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
252:         {
253:           continue;
254:         }
255: 
256:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
257:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
258:              sizeof(desc->message));
259:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
260:       desc->used = true;
261:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
262:       mbox_process_desc();
263:     }
264: 
265:   mbox_process_desc();
266: 
267:   return OK;
268: }

222:   if (g_link_state != state)
223:     {
224:       if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
225:         {
226:           g_stats.link_ready++;
227:         }
228:       else if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
229:         {
230:           g_stats.link_down++;
231:           g_down_since = clock_systime_ticks();
232:         }
233: 
234:       g_link_state = state;
235:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
236:       g_diag_state = state;
237:       nxsem_post(&g_diag_sem);
238:     }
239: }

241: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
242:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
243:                                  int result)
244: {
245:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
246: 
247:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
248:     {
249:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
250:       channel->queued = false;
251:       channel->result = result;
252:     }
253: 
254:   if (active->callback != NULL)
255:     {
256:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
257:     }
258: 
259:   active->busy = false;
260:   if (result == OK)
261:     {
262:       release_acks_before(active->order);
263:     }
264: }
265: 
266: static void fail_pending(int result)
267: {
268:   unsigned int i;
269: 
270:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
271:     {
272:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
273: 
274:       if (channel->queued)
275:         {
276:           channel->queued = false;
277:           channel->result = result;
278:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
279:             {
280:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
281:             }
282:         }
283:     }
284: }

286: static void release_recovery_slots(void)
287: {
288:   unsigned int i;
289: 
290:   g_active.quarantine = false;
291:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
292:     {
293:       memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
294:     }
295: }
296: 
297: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
298: {
299:   unsigned int i;
300:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
301: 
302:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
303:     {
304:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
305:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
306:         {
307:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
308:           g_recovery_index = i;
309:           break;
310:         }
311:     }
312: 
313:   if (epoch == NULL)
314:     {
315:       uint32_t newest = 0;
316: 
317:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
318:         {
319:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
320:             {
321:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
322:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
323:               g_recovery_index = i;
324:             }
325:         }
326: 
327:       epoch->replay = true;
328:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
329:     }
330:   else
331:     {
332:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
333:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
334:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
335:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
336:     }
337: 
338:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
339:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
340:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
341:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
342:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
343: }
344: 
345: static void begin_abort(int result)
346: {
347:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
348: 
349:   if (g_active.busy)
350:     {
351:       g_active.quarantine = true;
352:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
353:     }
354: 
355:   if (probe != NULL)
356:     {
357:       probe->quarantine = true;
358:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
359:     }
360: 
361:   fail_pending(result);
362:   g_probe_requested = false;
363:   select_recovery_epoch();
364: }
365: 
366: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
367: {
368:   unsigned int i;
369: 
370:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
371:     {
372:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
373:         {
374:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
375:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
376:         }
377:     }
378: 
379:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
380:   return NULL;
381: }
382: 
383: static int dispatch_locked(void)
384: {
385:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
386:   struct active_transaction *active;
387:   struct logical_channel *channel;
388:   unsigned int i;
389:   int ret;
390: 
391:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
392: 
393:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
394:     {
395:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
396:         {
397:           continue;
398:         }
399: 
400:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
401:       if (ret < 0)
402:         {
403:           return ret;
404:         }
405: 
406:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
407:     }
408: 
409:   if (g_reset_pending)
410:     {
411:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
412:       if (ret < 0)
413:         {
414:           return ret;
415:         }
416: 
417:       g_reset_pending = false;
418:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
419:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
420:     }
421: 
422:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
423:     {
424:       return OK;
425:     }
426: 
427:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
428:     {
429:       channel = &g_channels[i];
430:       if (!channel->queued)
431:         {
432:           continue;
433:         }
434: 
435:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
436:         {
437:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
438:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
439:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
440:             {
441:               continue;
442:             }
443: 
444:           active = &epoch->probe;
445:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
446:             {
447:               return -ENOLINK;
448:             }
449:         }
450:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
451:         {
452:           active = &g_active;
453:           if (active->quarantine)
454:             {
455:               return -ENOLINK;
456:             }
457:         }
458:       else
459:         {
460:           return OK;
461:         }
462: 
463:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
464:         {
465:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
466:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
467:                  sizeof(active->message));
468:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
469:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
470:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
471:             g_channel_ids[i]);
472:         }
473: 
474:       active->callback = channel->callback;
475:       active->arg = channel->arg;
476:       active->channel_index = i;
477:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
478:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       active->busy = true;
485:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
486:         {
487:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
488:             {
489:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
490:             }
491: 
492:           g_probe_attempts++;
493:           g_stats.probes++;
494:         }
495: 
496:       return OK;
497:     }
498: 
499:   return OK;
500: }
501: 
502: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
503:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
504: {
505:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
506: 
507:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
508:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
509:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
510:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
511:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
512:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
513:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
514: }
515: 
516: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
517: {
518:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
519:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
520:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
521: }
522: 
523: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
524: {
525:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
526:   struct active_transaction *active;
527:   bool replay;
528:   int result;
529: 
530:   active = busy_probe();
531:   if (active == NULL)
532:     {
533:       active = &g_active;
534:     }
535: 
536:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
537:     {
538:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
539:       return;
540:     }
541: 
542:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
543:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
544:     {
545:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
546: 
547:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
548:       return;
549:     }
550: 
551:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
552:     {
553:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
554:       return;
555:     }
556: 
557:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
558:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
559: 
560:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
561:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
562:     {
563:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
564:     }
565: 
566:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
567:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
568:   if (replay)
569:     {
570:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
571:       unsigned int i;
572: 
573:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
574:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
575:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
576:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
577:        */
578: 
579:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
580:       g_active.quarantine = false;
581:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
582:         {
583:           if (i != replay_index)
584:             {
585:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
586:             }
587:         }
588: 
589:       select_recovery_epoch();
590:       (void)dispatch_locked();
591:       return;
592:     }
593: 
594:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
595: 
596:   if (g_probe_requested && g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
597:     {
598:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
599:     }
600: 
601:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
602:     {
603:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
604:         {
605:           release_recovery_slots();
606:           g_recovery_index = 0;
607:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
608:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
609:         }
610:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
611:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
612:         {
613:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
614:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
615:            */
616:         }
617:       else
618:         {
619:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
620:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
621:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
622:         }
623:     }
624: 
625:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
626:            result < 0)
627:     {
628:       begin_abort(result);
629:     }
630: 
631:   (void)dispatch_locked();
632: }
633: 
634: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
635: {
636:   struct ack_slot *slot;
637:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
638:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
639:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
640:   uint8_t state = 0;
641:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
642: 
643:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
644:     {
645:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
646:       if (slot == NULL)
647:         {
648:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
649:           return -EAGAIN;
650:         }
651:     }
652:   else
653:     {
654:       slot = NULL;
655:     }
656: 
657:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
658:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
659:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
660:     {
661:       g_stats.bad_header++;
662:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
663:     }
664:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
665:     {
666:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
667:       if (ret < 0)
668:         {
669:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
670:         }
671:     }
672:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
673:     {
674:       g_pwc_rx(message);
675:       ret = OK;
676:     }
677:   else
678:     {
679:       g_stats.unsupported++;
680:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
681:     }
682: 
683:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
684:     {
685:       return OK;
686:     }
687: 
688:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
689:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
690:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
691:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
692:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
693: 
694:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
695:     {
696:       g_probe_requested = true;
697:     }
698: 
699:   (void)dispatch_locked();
700:   return OK;
701: }
702: 
703: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
704: {
705:   irqstate_t flags;
706:   uint8_t control;
707: 
708:   flags = up_irq_save();
709:   g_stats.rx++;
710:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
711: 
712:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
713:     {
714:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
715:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
716:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
717:         {
718:           g_stats.bad_header++;
719:         }
720:       else
721:         {
722:           g_stats.resets++;
723:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
727:     {
728:       handle_ack(message);
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       int ret = handle_command(message);
733: 
734:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
735:         {
736:           up_irq_restore(flags);
737:           return ret;
738:         }
739:     }
740: 
741:   up_irq_restore(flags);
742:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
743:   return OK;
744: }

746: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
747: {
748:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
749: 
750:   (void)argc;
751:   (void)argv;
752:   for (;;)
753:     {
754:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
755:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
756:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
757:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
758:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
759:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
760:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
761:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
762: 
763:       up_irq_restore(flags);
764:       if (reported == state)
765:         {
766:           continue;
767:         }
768: 
769:       reported = state;
770:       syslog(reported == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
771:              "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
772:              reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
773:              (unsigned long)bad_ack);
774:       if (callback != NULL)
775:         {
776:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
777:         }
778:     }
779: 
780:   return OK;
781: }

783: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
784: {
785:   (void)argc;
786:   (void)argv;
787: 
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       struct active_transaction *probe;
791:       irqstate_t flags;
792:       bool request_probe;
793: 
794:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
795:       flags = up_irq_save();
796: 
797:       probe = busy_probe();
798:       if ((g_active.busy &&
799:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
800:           (probe != NULL &&
801:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
802:         {
803:           g_stats.timeout++;
804:           if (probe != NULL)
805:             {
806:               probe->quarantine = true;
807:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
808:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
809:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
810:             }
811:           else
812:             {
813:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
814:             }
815:         }
816: 
817:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
818:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
819:         {
820:           select_recovery_epoch();
821:         }
822: 
823:       (void)dispatch_locked();
824:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
825:                       (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ||
826:                        g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING) &&
827:                       !g_channels[2].queued && !g_active.busy;
828:       if (request_probe)
829:         {
830:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
831:           g_probe_requested = false;
832:         }
833: 
834:       up_irq_restore(flags);
835: 
836:       if (request_probe)
837:         {
838:           bk7258_mb_uart_start();
839:         }
840:     }
841: 
842:   return OK;
843: }

879:   return OK;

906: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
907:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
908:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
909: {
910:   struct logical_channel *channel;
911:   unsigned int index;
912:   irqstate_t flags;
913:   int ret;
914: 
915:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
916:     {
917:       return -EAGAIN;
918:     }
919:

372:       g_uart.state_pending = false;
373:       g_uart.stats.state_tx++;
374:     }
375: 
376:   return ret;
377: }

379: static int send_data_locked(void)
380: {
381:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
382:   uint8_t *destination =
383:     (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
384:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
385:   uint16_t first;
386:   int ret;
387: 
388:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
389:     {
390:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
391:     }
392: 
393:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)
394:     {
395:       return -EAGAIN;
396:     }
397: 
398:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
399:   if (first > length)
400:     {
401:       first = length;
402:     }
403: 
404:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
405:   if (first != length)
406:     {
407:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
408:     }
409: 
410:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
411:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
412:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
413:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
414:   message.payload_length = length;
415:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
416:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
417:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
418:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
419:   if (ret == OK)
420:     {
421:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
422:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
423:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
424:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
425:     }
426: 
427:   return ret;
428: }

430: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
431: {
432:   (void)argc;
433:   (void)argv;
434: 
435:   for (;;)
436:     {
437:       bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
438:       void *callback_arg;
439:       irqstate_t flags;
440: 
441:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
442:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
443:       flags = up_irq_save();
444: 
445:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)
446:         {
447:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
448: 
449:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
450:             {
451:               (void)send_state_locked();
452:             }
453:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
454:             {
455:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
456:                 {
457:                   (void)send_state_locked();
458:                 }
459:               else
460:                 {
461:                   (void)send_data_locked();
462:                 }
463:             }
464:         }
465: 
466:       callback = g_uart.callback;
467:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;
468:       up_irq_restore(flags);
469: 
470:       if (callback != NULL)
471:         {
472:           callback(callback_arg);
473:         }
474:     }
475: 
476:   return OK;
477: }

548: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
549: {
550:   irqstate_t flags;
551:   uint16_t available;
552:   uint16_t written;
553:   uint16_t first;
554: 
555:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
556:     {
557:       return -EINVAL;
558:     }
559: 
560:   if (length == 0)
561:     {
562:       return 0;
563:     }
564: 
565:   flags = up_irq_save();
566:   available = tx_free();
567:   written = length > available ? available : length;
568:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
569:   if (first > written)
570:     {
571:       first = written;
572:     }
573: 
574:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
575:   if (first != written)
576:     {
577:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
578:     }
579: 
580:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
581:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
582:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
583:   if (written < length)
584:     {
585:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
586:     }
587: 
588:   up_irq_restore(flags);
589:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
590:     {
591:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
592:     }
593: 
594:   return written;
595: }

597: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,
598:                               unsigned int *status)
599: {
600:   irqstate_t flags;
601:   uint16_t available;
602:   uint16_t count;
603:   uint16_t first;
604: 
605:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
606:     {
607:       return -EINVAL;
608:     }
609: 
610:   flags = up_irq_save();
611:   available = rx_count();
612:   count = length > available ? available : length;
613:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
614:   if (first > count)
615:     {
616:       first = count;
617:     }
618: 
619:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);
620:   if (first != count)
621:     {
622:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
623:     }
624: 
625:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
626:   if (status != NULL)
627:     {
628:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
629:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
630:     }
631: 
632:   if (!g_uart.upper_rts && g_uart.local_rts &&
633:       rx_count() < MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE)
634:     {
635:       update_local_rts();
636:     }
637: 
638:   up_irq_restore(flags);
639:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
640:     {
641:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
642:     }
643: 
644:   return count;
645: }

696: int bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(unsigned int timeout_ms)
697: {
698:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
699: 
700:   if (!g_uart.initialized || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
701:     {
702:       return -EAGAIN;
703:     }
704: 
705:   while (!bk7258_mbox_uart_txempty())
706:     {
707:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
708:         {
709:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
710:         }
711: 
712:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
713:     }
714: 
715:   return OK;
716: }

29: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
30:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
31:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200

36: typedef struct

38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */

40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
45: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
46: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
47: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
48: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
49: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;

54:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
55:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
56:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
57:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
58:  */
59: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
60: 
61: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
62: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04

105: 	volatile u8		tx_state;				/* logical channel tx state. */
